name: misakanet-failure-memory
title_zh: 让 AI 代理把调试经验存成可检索的微课库
tagline_zh: 调试翻车后，经验只留在对话里？这个 skill 让代理把踩坑记录写成 git 微课，下次同类报错直接搜到解法。
tagline_en: Debugging wisdom dies in chat logs. This skill lets agents commit micro-lessons to a git-backed library, so the.
desc_en: 📚 A zero-dependency, git-backed micro-lesson library for AI Agents to asynchronously share and search verified debugging experience. Python stdlib only. | https://misakanet.org
why_zh: 零依赖、纯 Python 标准库，git 即数据库。代理间异步共享验证过的解法，不靠 prompt 记。
why_en: Zero-dependency, stdlib-only, git as the database. Agents share verified fixes asynchronously via auditable, versioned facts—not.
limit_zh: 只存文本微课，不解析代码或日志；检索靠关键词匹配，语义模糊就搜不到。需要代理主动调用写入，否则库永远是空的。
limit_en: Text-only micro-lessons; no code/log parsing. Keyword search only—semantic queries miss. Agents must actively write; otherwise the library stays.
